newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Spicer-Mitchell, City warn on half year.
newsitem.headline: Spicer-Mitchell, City warn on half year.

text.p: South Africa's Spicer-Mitchell Holdings Ltd and City Investment Holdings Ltd said on Monday that their half year results to June 30 had been hit by tough markets.
"(The results) have been negatively effected by continuing adverse business conditions prevailing in the aluminium extrusion and geyser manufacturing industries," the firms said in a statement.

They added that several projects were currently underway to restructure both firms' interests in those markets, but that shareholders should use caution when trading in the firms' stock until further details are announced.
